description: This Java class 'DateOrDatetimeEditor' is a property editor that converts between String representation and java.util.Date objects. It handles parsing date and date-time formats, but does not support partial dates.

classes.name: DateOrDatetimeEditor
classes.description: A property editor class for converting between String and Date objects, supporting full date and date-time formats.

methods.name: setAsText
methods.description: Parses a String to a Date object, trying date+time format first, then date only. Throws IllegalArgumentException if parsing fails.

methods.name: getAsText
methods.description: Formats the Date object into a String, using date or date-time format based on the presence of time components.
